# Pixelify Sans

Pixel-art typeface for the Crew Office interface (headings, buttons, badges, speech
bubbles), matching the pixel textures of the office scene.

- Source: `@fontsource/pixelify-sans@5.3.0` on npm (latin subset, weights 400 and 700),
  from the Pixelify Sans project, https://github.com/eifetx/Pixelify-Sans
- Licence: SIL Open Font License 1.1 — see LICENSE in this folder.
